newsitem.title: INDONESIA: President Suharto to name 200 millionth Indonesian.
newsitem.headline: President Suharto to name 200 millionth Indonesian.

text.p: President Suharto will name the baby that brings Indonesia's population up to 200 million, the official Antara news agency said on Wednesday.

Minister of State for Population and Family Planning Haryono Suyono was quoted as saying the lucky baby, expected to be born on February 4, would also get a surprise birthday gift from the government.
He said at least 8,182 babies were expected to be born on February 4.
Suyono said that in order to qualify for the honour of being named by Suharto, the baby must have legally married parents.
The mother should have been over 20 years old when she got married and must have undergone regular medical checks during pregnancy.
"The baby should not be born by a Caesarean section either," he said without elaborating.
Indonesia is the world's fourth most populous country after China, India and United States.
